method: After the blind freeze was pushed, compare each holdout scenario's operation sequence and pass oracle with all 31 public scenarios. Shared commission properties are not by themselves duplication; a case is a restatement when its operative fault and required behavior add no independent dimension.

cases.independent_dimension: locally resolvable but unpublished commit after valid staging
declared commit resolves while the valid manifest exists only in a sibling tree
declared pin remains byte-valid while only one artifact is superseded at the mutable ref
identical replay occurs after terminal completion and process-memory loss
conflicting replay occurs after terminal completion and process-memory loss
generic terminal-state regression followed by a second completion
stale holder changes idempotency identity after transfer
forged higher token is paired with a plausible guessed lease identity after eleven real grants
current lease submits a result bound to a superseded attempt input
lost acknowledgement followed by two barrier-synchronised replays

cases.reason: Both cases require refusal of non-identical content under one idempotency key with exactly one ingestion. Reusing the commit label does not add a materially different invariant.

cases.independent_dimension: current and stale fenced commits cross one execution barrier
truncation is concealed by appending a different internally valid suffix
attacker recomputes the entire descendant hash cascade after a historical edit
two individually valid ledger suffixes equivocate from one predecessor
different display names resolve to one authenticated principal
legitimate reviewer retries the same review after an earlier ordering refusal
a real diagnostic commit accompanies an honest terminal failure and must not be promoted
tools-only validator import with schema absent must fail through a controlled process result
entire provider loss, remote discovery and external-effect non-duplication are asserted together
uncommitted rerun occurs after an external effect but before result staging
old checkpoint from a valid lease replays after restart
heartbeat and expiry scan race at one logical-time boundary
one write set combines dot-segment traversal and an allowlist-escaping symlink target
valid dot-prefixed workflow and invalid lookalike basename are adjudicated together
clean bootstrap runs beside poisoned matching temporary state and without warm-only refs
hash rejection must remain durable and schedule recovery after controller restart
decorative result attempt fields conflict with durable lease and checkpoint state
real commit resolves only in an undeclared remote rather than the frozen result slot
unauthorized completion refusal must not poison one later authorized completion
artifact mutation occurs in the verification-to-commit race window
scanner must inspect historical duplicate completion when the latest projection appears valid

treatment: H11 remains byte-identically present in the frozen suite and in all transcripts. It is reported as a novelty defect and is not silently removed, rewritten or used to justify PASS.
